name: Giovani Batista
bio: I turn high-volume, messy inputs — leads, budgets, schedules, compliance records — into standardized systems people can actually track. MBA with hands-on experience across RevOps, athletics administration, and financial operations.

projects.title: Tableau Public Portfolio
projects.description: A growing collection of interactive dashboards and visualizations, built to explore real datasets and communicate findings clearly.

projects.title: Cyclistic Bike-Share Case Study
projects.description: An end-to-end SQL, Excel, and Tableau analysis comparing how casual riders and annual members use a bike-share service, built to inform a data-driven marketing recommendation.

experience.title: Talent Support Advisor
experience.subtitle: Pipeline Operations & Lead Qualification · ASM Sports (Sports Talent Management & Consulting), Takoma Park, MD
bullets: Executed first-touch outreach across 500+ leads per cycle within a team-wide pipeline of 4,250+ prospects, using a structured 5-touchpoint cadence (call, text, and email) to maximize response rates.
Achieved a 30%+ live-connect rate on first-attempt cold outreach, converting roughly 1 in 3 contacts into an active consultation conversation.

Qualified and booked 85+ consultations per cycle, driving a 45% positive-outcome rate at final-stage interviews through standardized discovery workflows and a repeatable multichannel outreach cadence.
Allocated ~40% of personally-sourced leads to senior recruiters as sales-ready candidates, directly supporting business development for the Agent Advisory program.

Maintained CRM-style tracking across 500+ candidate records, ensuring clean pipeline documentation, accurate handoffs to senior recruiters, and full visibility into qualification status and follow-up stages.

experience.title: Digital Operations & Business Strategy Analyst
experience.subtitle: PhiloSoccer Academy (Digital Media & Analytics), Takoma Park, MD
bullets: Built a centralized digital initiative tracker covering 300+ tasks across content, website, campaigns, and analytics — documenting owners, deadlines, follow-up status, and execution progress to improve operational accountability.

Drove a 964% increase in impressions and 867% growth in engagement over 3 months by standardizing content planning, refining channel strategy, and increasing posting consistency based on performance data.
Increased Instagram Reels interactions by 104% and saves by 234% by identifying content funnel gaps and reallocating effort toward high-performing formats.
Analyzed CPC, reach, and campaign performance trends using Meta Insights and Metricool to identify underperforming ads and recommend budget reallocations that improved ROI.
Coordinated cross-functional workflows across website, content, analytics, and paid channels — establishing ownership frameworks that reduced task duplication and improved on-time delivery.

experience.title: Graduate Assistant
experience.subtitle: Athletics Operations & Project Coordination · Washington Adventist University, Takoma Park, MD
bullets: Supported reporting and compliance workflows for a $1M+ athletic scholarship fund by standardizing documentation, tracking approval stages, and maintaining real-time visibility into open items for athletics administrators.

Built 6+ Excel-based operational trackers for expenses, scholarship approvals, athlete performance, scheduling, and compliance — centralizing data previously managed across disconnected spreadsheets and email threads.
Prepared weekly academic, performance, and compliance reports for 60+ student-athletes by consolidating data from multiple sources, reducing manual consolidation time by an estimated 40%.
Managed end-to-end logistics for 15+ program trips involving 20+ stakeholders — overseeing scheduling, documentation, budget tracking, and expense approvals with zero compliance violations.
Standardized 5+ recurring reporting workflows and built open-item trackers and documentation templates that reduced manual follow-up and improved cross-team coordination.

experience.title: Student Life Manager
experience.subtitle: Program & Operations Coordination · Coffeyville Community College, Coffeyville, KS
bullets: Coordinated logistics, scheduling, and stakeholder communication for 30+ campus events per academic year; introduced Excel-based event tracking that improved attendance data access and follow-up consistency.
Managed scheduling, academic coordination, and communication workflows for 50+ student-athletes, serving as the operational liaison between athletics, administration, and student-life departments.
Implemented Excel tracking systems for student engagement, athletics operations, and event execution that centralized attendance, scheduling, and follow-up data across departments.

experience.title: Accountant Clerk
experience.subtitle: Deconto Ltda., Porto Alegre, Brazil
bullets: Maintained accounting documentation and completed bank reconciliations for 15 client accounts, supporting accurate financial recordkeeping and audit preparation.
Recorded journal entries and classified expenses to support balance sheet preparation and improve reporting accuracy.
Supported tax compliance by preparing and uploading revenue documentation through government portals, including FGTS-related records.
Coordinated with accountants and legal staff to ensure accurate handling of payroll, tax, and compliance documentation.

experience.title: Assistant Operations Manager
experience.subtitle: Fiorio & Fachini Ltda., Porto Alegre, Brazil
bullets: Maintained service consistency for ~65 customers per day by proactively identifying workflow bottlenecks and managing staffing needs.
Coordinated shift operations across a 4-person team, managing service flow and customer support during peak periods.
Analyzed point-of-sale patterns to resolve recurring operational inefficiencies and improve transaction throughput.
Supported local marketing efforts by developing promotional materials and strengthening the business's Google presence to increase neighborhood visibility.
